changelog:
• Zona 5 TV Player (State Peek & D-Pad Bertingkat): Navigasi bertingkat ControlBar -> Peek (140dp) -> Suggestions, auto-hide timer presisi (5s/10s), serta responsif TV 720p–4K.
• Ketajaman Visual & Coil ARGB_8888: Menghilangkan banding gradasi gelap poster, rasio 2:3 bebas teks terpotong, serta resolusi tinggi TV backdrop (1080p EXACT).
• Kehalusan Swap Player & Anti-Layar Hitam: Transisi video tanpa jeda layar hitam via continuous media item & cover fade out.
• Gestur Terpadu Mobile: Single tap instan dan double tap seek presisi tanpa konflik pada pemutar video.
